name: CallTrackingMetrics
description: Search tracked calls and texts and list your CallTrackingMetrics accounts.

fields.label: Access key
fields.help: In CallTrackingMetrics open Settings > API Integration, enable API access and copy the Access Key.

fields.label: Secret key
fields.help: On the same page click "Show Secret" and copy the Secret Key.

actions.name: List accounts
actions.description: Lists the accounts your keys can reach (to find the account ID).

actions.name: Search calls
actions.description: Finds calls (and texts) in a date range.

inputs.label: Account ID
inputs.help: The number in your CallTrackingMetrics address, or use "List accounts".
